run_experiment: run the experiment using a Hydra config that sets up logging and tracks status
review_run_function: review the run function that creates a LogBook and executes experiments with status tracking
refactor_run_function: refactor the run function to add custom loggers or modify experiment status handling
summarize_run_entry_point: summarize the main entry point that pretty prints config and runs experiments via LogBook
test_run_function: test the run function by passing a mock config with setup id and logbook settings
